title: Featured Projects
text:
Traffic Mobility – Medical Center Drive

Applied computer vision and multimodal analytics to evaluate vehicle operations, pedestrian activity, and curbside interaction within a high-activity medical campus environment
Identified circulation patterns, access behaviors, localized delays, and pedestrian movement hotspots
Supported data-driven recommendations for operational improvements, access management, and pedestrian safety enhancements

title: Featured Projects
text:
Curbside Management – Sarratt Circle

Used computer vision analytics to quantify curbside activity, dwell times, and vehicle obstructions affecting campus shuttle operations
Identified recurring curbside violations, operational conflicts, and high-impact periods affecting shuttle circulation
Supported recommendations for curbside management, operational efficiency, and multimodal safety improvements

title: Featured Projects
text:
Travel Behavior – Pedestrian Stress Study

Uses wearable sensors to measure stress in real-world environments
Identifies high-risk locations using physiological data
Supports human-centered infrastructure design

title: Featured Projects
section: Heat Stress Monitoring and Worker Safety
text:
Heat Stress Monitoring and Worker Safety

Investigates physiological and environmental indicators of heat stress in occupational settings
Integrates wearable sensors, environmental data, and machine learning for real-time heat strain detection
Supports data-driven safety practices that reduce heat-related risks and improve workforce resilience

title: Featured Projects
section: Predictive Analytics and Decision Support Systems
text:
Predictive Analytics and Decision Support Systems

Combines transportation, environmental, and weather data to create comprehensive monitoring and forecasting frameworks
Applies machine learning to identify patterns, predict future conditions, and improve system performance
Evaluates the factors influencing traffic patterns, safety risks, and air quality outcomes to support evidence-based decision-making
Enables data-driven planning, policy evaluation, and operational decision-making for transportation agencies and communities

title: Featured Projects
section: Transportation Demand Management and Commute Behavior Analytics
text:
Transportation Demand Management and Commute Behavior Analytics

Evaluates the effectiveness of commute incentives and transportation demand management strategies
Examines how incentive structures influence driving and sustainable travel behavior
Supports data-driven transportation planning, sustainability goals, and policy development

title: Core Capabilities
text:
High-Resolution Multimodal Mobility Data Collection and Analytics
Collection and analysis of multimodal transportation activity across real-world environments.


Real-Time Detection, Tracking, and Post-Processed Analytics
Computer vision workflows for detection, tracking, classification, and event extraction.


Curbside Behavior and Obstruction Analysis
Measurement of curbside activity, dwell times, obstructions, and access conflicts.


Intersection and Crossing Insights
Evaluation of pedestrian activity, crossings, conflict zones, and movement patterns.


Transportation Operations, Traffic, and Mobility Pattern Assessment
Analysis of traffic operations, circulation, access behavior, and mobility patterns.


Wearable Sensing for Non-Motorized Mobility Stress Detection and Heat Exposure Monitoring
Use of wearable sensors to evaluate stress, heat exposure, and human-centered mobility outcomes.


Environmental Monitoring and Transportation Emissions Assessment
Integration of environmental sensing, air quality data, and transportation activity measures.


Predictive Analytics and Decision Support Systems
Forecasting and analytical tools to support planning, policy evaluation, and operational decision-making.


Integration of Transportation, Environmental, and Behavioral Data
Data fusion across mobility, environmental, physiological, and behavioral data sources.

Empowering Researchers and Practitioners with Data-Driven Solutions
ADVISOR combines sensing and analytics systems to study multimodal transportation, human behavior, and environmental conditions in real-world settings. Our work combines computer vision, wearable devices, and data analytics to generate actionable insights for safe, efficient, and resilient outcomes.

Key Focus Areas

Safety Risks and Conflict Zones

Human Experience
